visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark brown hair and a black textured blazer speaks directly to the camera in a bright studio environment. (2) A side-by-side comparison frame appears, showing a messy hairstyle on the left and a styled version on the right. (3) A woman with blonde hair wearing a black dress enters the frame and begins using a hair dryer and a pink round brush on the man's hair. (4) Close-up shots focus on the styling technique, showing the brush lifting the hair at the roots while the dryer applies heat. (5) The camera cuts between the man's face, his hair being styled, and the blonde stylist explaining her actions. (6) A series of product shots appear, featuring white and red bottles labeled 'Scalp Recovery' and 'Youth Serum' being used with a dropper. (7) Graphics overlay the screen showing product bundles, prices, and a '79折' (21% off) discount badge. (8) The man and the stylist pose together at the end, with the man holding the products up to the camera while smiling.

(2) A transition sound effect, a sharp 'whoosh,' occurs during the visual cut to the comparison. (3) The female voice enters with a clear, instructional tone as the sound of a hair dryer (broadband white noise) is mixed into the background. (4) Multiple 'pop' and 'ting' SFX are utilized to highlight the appearance of on-screen text and graphics. (5) The conversation between the male and female speakers maintains a high speech rate with minimal pauses, emphasizing a conversational yet professional vibe. (6) The BGM remains consistent throughout, providing a steady upbeat tempo that complements the instructional content.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Problem/Hook -> Tutorial/Demonstration -> Product Testimony -> Promo/Price Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for Scalp Recovery hair care products. It uses a hairstyle tutorial as a hook to demonstrate the effectiveness of the products and concludes with a call-to-action for a group buy discount.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of product benefits, display of prices, and a group buy link call-to-action.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video efficiently combines infotainment with direct selling, typical of social media influencer marketing. The fast editing and use of variety-show style subtitles are designed to keep the viewer's attention during the promotional segments.
